children: Voters in Australia's southern state of Victoria are expected to hand the current Labor government a huge defeat at elections on Saturday. The mood is grim for the party, and if the drubbing is delivered, questions will be asked about what it means for the federal Labor government. It is likely to officially establish the right-wing populist One Nation party as a force that could impact the status quo in the federal arena. History has shown that voters can vote one way at state level and then another at federal elections. But Saturday's poll feels like it will be a watershed in Australian politics and the fallout could have big ramifications.(james.glynn@wsj.com; @JamesGlynnWSJ)
